publication.title: Post-Lie nonexistence with a semisimple target

scope: A finite-dimensional complex unimodular source with two Lie homomorphisms into a same-dimensional semisimple target and invertible difference is semisimple. Therefore a perfect nonsemisimple complex source and semisimple target admit no post-Lie product.

exact_row: Post-Lie nonexistence with a semisimple target. Problem30005737 / OWR-14298013-001; PR894. Resolves the finite-dimensional complex perfect nonsemisimple-source question by a proved unimodular transverse-pair obstruction. Credits established post-Lie correspondence, Baues determinant method and classical Lie-group topology. Bounded priority audit; no historical firstness, exhaustive literature or continued-openness certificate.
